title.en: AN ACT APPROPRIATING TWO MILLION DOLLARS, MEXICAN, TO BE USED IN THE CONSTRUCTION AND REPAIR OF HIGHWAYS AND BRIDGES IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS.
title.orig: AN ACT APPROPRIATING TWO MILLION DOLLARS, MEXICAN, TO BE USED IN THE CONSTRUCTION AND REPAIR OF HIGHWAYS AND BRIDGES IN THE PHILIPPINE ISLANDS.
title.vi: Đạo luật cấp hai triệu đô la Mexico để xây dựng và sửa chữa đường cao tốc và cầu tại quần đảo Philippines

title.id: Undang-Undang tentang Pengalokasian Dua Juta Dolar Meksiko untuk Pembangunan dan Perbaikan Jalan Raya serta Jembatan di Kepulauan Filipina
title.ms: Akta Mengenai Peruntukan Dua Juta Dolar Mexico bagi Pembinaan dan Pembaikan Jalan Raya dan Jambatan di Kepulauan Filipina

source.name: The LawPhil Project — Arellano Law Foundation

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil PDF 文本化成果（第三方 OCR，非机翻），原始文件 ACT_00001_1900_html.txt

text.en:
The sum of two million dollars, Mexican, is hereby Mexican money, appropriated out of any
money in the Insular Treasury, not otherwise appropriated, to be expended in the immediate construction and
repair of highways and bridges in the Philippine Islands.

The sum so appropriated shall be expended under the Expenditure, direction of the Military
Governor in the construction and repair of such highways and bridges as in his judgment may be most
conducive to the public welfare.

The Insular Treasurer is hereby authorized and directed to pay the warrants of the Military
Governor for the sum so appropriated.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, September 12, 1900.
